name: X Search Digest
description: Searches X through Xquik, normalizes results, and builds an email-ready social listening digest.

parameters.content:
## Xquik API key
Create a Header Auth credential: X-API-Key = your Xquik key, and select it on Search X with Xquik. Edit query/limit in Search Settings. This reads one response and returns tweets/digest/cursor without posting or paging automatically. No key or environment expression is stored in this template.
